description: Create an image from a text description with the same models as the WaveSpeed /chat page (seedream-5-pro, nano-banana-2.1, nano-banana-2, nano-banana-pro, gpt-image-2.5, gpt-image-2; default seedream-5-pro). Give reference_images to use existing images as subject, product, face or style (the model's edit endpoint is used). To change existing images use edit_image. In the prompt, name input media as @image 1, @image 2, @video 1, @audio 1 (counted in the order the lists are given); they are renamed to what the model expects.

aspect_ratio.description: e.g. 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4; snapped to what the model supports. If omitted: text-to-image is 1:1; with input images it is determined automatically from the input image.

estimate_only.description: true: only return the price estimate and the request that would run. Nothing is submitted or charged.

model.description: Only when the user names a model; default is the first (Seedream 5 Pro).

prompt.description: Complete visual prompt: subject, composition, style, lighting, mood.

reference_images.description: Optional images whose subject, product, face or style the new image should use: public URLs, or "@./path" for local files (uploaded automatically).

resolution.description: Only when the user asks for a size.

wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the result in this call (default 0: return the prediction id right away)

name: generate_image
